title: Interaction valence reveals contrasting social networks in dairy cattle
abstract: arXiv:2608.19222v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Social relationships shape access to resources, exposure to conflict and group stability, yet automated livestock monitoring typically treats behaviour as isolated events. Here, we present a valence-aware social-network framework that transforms video-derived interactions into herd-level representations of affiliative and agonistic organization. A pose-based computer-vision pipeline analysed 7 h 39 min of continuous video from the pre-milking area of one commercial dairy farm. After quality control, 1,183 of 1,414 candidate interactions remained, involving 36 cows and 177 dyads. In a predicted-class-balanced audit of 198 pipeline-detected clips, automated and manual labels agreed in 82.8% of cases, with an unweighted audit-sample macro-F1 of 0.872. translated_title: 互动效价揭示奶牛社交网络中的对比结构
translated_abstract: 社交关系塑造了对资源的获取、冲突暴露和群体稳定性，然而自动化的牲畜监测通常将行为视为孤立事件。在此，我们提出一个效价感知的社交网络框架，将视频衍生的互动转化为牛群层面的亲和性与对抗性组织表征。一个基于姿态的计算机视觉流程分析了来自一个商业奶牛场挤奶前区域的7小时39分钟的连续视频。经过质量控制，1,414个候选互动中的1,183个被保留，涉及36头牛和177对配对。在预测类别平衡的198个管道检测片段审计中，自动和手动标签在82.8%的情况下一致，未加权审计样本宏F1为0.872。这些值描述了审计样本，而非患病率加权或端到端部署性能。聚合网络是连通的（密度=0.281；传递性=0.513；均值）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种效价感知的社交网络框架，通过姿态计算机视觉分析奶牛视频互动，首次区分亲和性与对抗性社交关系，并在审计中实现了82.8%的标签一致性和0.872的宏F1分数。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a valence-aware social network framework that uses pose-based computer vision to analyze dairy cattle video interactions, distinguishing affiliative and agonistic relationships for the first time, achieving 82.8% label agreement and 0.872 macro-F1 in audits.
